name: Cedwyn site-wide version scheme
rule: The newest version of any product (each e-book, each documentary scene) is v0.0.2 and costs £4.99. The version before it is v0.0.1 and is free. Older versions count backwards by creation date as -v0.0.1, -v0.0.2, -v0.0.3 … (most recent older = -v0.0.1), all free. Each version is its own version; no ranges. In a hashtag the minus becomes an underscore and nothing goes before it: #v0.0.2, #v0.0.1, #_v0.0.1, #_v0.0.2. A reserved, not yet made version is #next. Prices are unchanged; the bundle stays as listed.
readers: /documentary/ (documentary.js 1.6.2 reads this file; built-in defaults match)
/ebooks/ (edition labels and the About versions text follow this rule)
